notes.title: Transistor -- Patch v1.26010 Release Notes
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who purchased Transistor on launch day! Some users have reported problems with the game on their systems and we're working to resolve them as quickly as possible. We've deployed an update that addresses some of those problems:


Fixed some crash issues on some hardware configurations
Fixed a crash at the end of Stability Test 1 of 3
Fixed issue where Red would sometimes run offscreen during Turn() execution
Fixed an exploit where users could prematurely install multiple Upgrades
Fix to noborder command line option
Double-clicking the .exe file in the install directory will launch the game directly
Improved diagnostic messaging for incompatible graphics cards
Minor text changes


For more information please visit our Technical Support FAQ. We appreciate your support and hope you enjoy the game.
